title: Prisma Studio Introduction
description: Explore and edit your database data visually using Prisma Studio.

data.text: **Prisma Studio** is a visual editor for your database data. It runs locally in your browser and lets you browse, create, update, and delete records without writing SQL.

data.title: Launch Prisma Studio
data.content: Run Prisma Studio from your terminal.

data.text: Prisma Studio opens at `http://localhost:5555`. You can browse tables, edit data, run raw queries, and visualize relations between tables.

data.title: Development Only
data.text: Prisma Studio is intended for development and debugging. Do not expose it in production environments.
